scope: Parent and current direct children only; read-only native counters; no metadata or provider calls

provenance.authorization: User explicitly requested observation of the ongoing CPU situation on 2026-10-23. Read-only counters; no provider listing, transcripts, messages, signals or workload changes.
provenance.stopped: Parent resource read became unavailable or its birth identity changed; elapsed time alone does not prove normal exit.
provenance.replay: First 151 scans; identical endpoints for every stride. Consecutive CPU deltas, or cumulative CPU if birth follows preceding listing. Baseline excluded. Default filters apply CPU > 25 OR footprint > 1e9 to each accepted interval.
limitations: Direct children only, not the full descendant tree or system.
Native usage reads can include zombies; production also checks BSD metadata and same-user lifetime identity.
No metadata enrichment, agent attribution, host counters or rendering during capture.
No final CPU recovery; baseline and never-observed work excluded.
Parent child counters are raw diagnostic observations, not an independent oracle or additive total.
One capture during a changing build; sampling phases and slower-rate replay cannot reproduce all timing effects of a separate live run.
